description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amendment to the Classes of Capital Transactions undertaken in Sri Lanka by a Person Resident outside Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which involves amendments to legal/regulatory frameworks governing foreign exchange transactions, capital investments, and financial compliance requirements. While it mentions the Minister of Finance, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the substantive legal regulations being promulgated.
